summary_en: Central Japan Railway authorized repurchase of up to 3.6 million shares for maximum 10 billion yen, representing 0.38% of issued shares excluding treasury stock, via market purchase from November 2 to November 30, 2026. All acquired shares will be cancelled on December 15, 2026.
title_en: Notice Regarding Determination of Matters Related to Repurchase of Treasury Stock and Cancellation of Treasury Stock
translation_en_brief: On October 28, 2026, Central Japan Railway's board of directors authorized a treasury stock repurchase program under Article 459(1) of the Companies Act and the company's Articles of Incorporation Article 34. The company will acquire up to 3.6 million ordinary shares representing a maximum 0.38% of issued shares (excluding treasury stock) for an upper limit of 10 billion yen through market purchases on the Tokyo Stock Exchange between November 2 and November 30, 2026. The acquisition is intended to enhance shareholder returns and improve capital efficiency. All shares acquired under this program will be cancelled effective December 15, 2026, pursuant to Article 178 of the Companies Act. As of September 30, 2026, the company held 44,996,993 treasury shares against 950,388,207 issued shares excluding treasury stock.
